facts.fact: The queen's seal is a lapis stone about a thumb-joint long, threaded on a cord through a hole in its shoulder, tied off in a warden's double hitch (two turns round the standing part, a tuck, a locking half-turn), and sewn into a hidden pocket in the seam at the nape of Rohan's coat.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Meera to find, hold and re-sew the seal and retie the cord in his knot (C11).

facts.fact: Meera's own habitual knot, taught by Bindu when she was five, is a flat reef with a half hitch; she unpicks it and ties the warden's double hitch instead.
facts.why: needed because C11 turns on her not using her own knot.

facts.fact: Meera burns four sticks to boil the juniper pot and uses the hut's juniper sprig from above the door for the steam; the bundle is not recounted on the page.
facts.why: needed to show the cost ledger of treating Rohan without contradicting the firewood count.
